bibl.title: Pindar's Olympian 1, 1-7 and its Relation to Bacchylides 3, 85-87.
bibl.seg: Chris Eckerman, Pindar's Olympian 1, 1-7 and its Relation to Bacchylides 3, 85-87.
bibl.note: Compares the metaphors in Pindar's Olympian 1, Bacchylides 3, 86-87 and P. Oxy. XXV, 2432 (= MP3 1912; LDAB 3922) (attributed to Simonides, less often to Bacchylides). - On water. - On the φίλον ἦτορ. - On the Sun. - Preliminary Conclusions. - Bacchylides' Pindar. - Conclusion.
